name: Pictures of Starving Children's Cell Records

podcast.body: Released in 1986, this record served as a direct critique of Bob Geldof and the Live Aid initiative, demonstrating the band's early engagement with politically charged themes and their anti-establishment stance. "One release that got attention was a 1986 record called Pictures of Starving Children's Cell Records, which was a take-down of Bob Galdoff and the whole Live Aid initiative."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 1
